item.title: Tsingshan may triple output at its Zimbabwe steel plant
item.description: Tsingshan Holding Group is considering as much as tripling output at a Zimbabwe steel plant it started in 2024, an expansion that could add to pressure on South Africa’s struggling steel industry as much of its production is exported to that country. Output of the Manhizhe steel plant, 205 kilometers (128 miles) southeast of the capital Harare may be raised to as much two-million tons from 600 000 t currently, said Benson Xu, chief executive officer of Tsingshan’s Zimbabwean unit. (via Australasia Global Mining News) #Zimbabwe #ZimbabweNews
